jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Typeface
We he lp the world’s biggest brands move from brief to fully personalized campaigns — in days, not months.

Founded by Abhay Parasnis and backed by Microsoft, GV, Salesforce, Lightspeed, Madrona and Menlo, we’re building category-defining technology at the intersection of creativity and AI with real impact. Join us to help shape the future of enterprise marketing.

What  You’ll  Do

As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll lead the development of AI-driven features and experiences from concept to launch. You’ll work at the intersection of product, data, and engineering, translating complex AI capabilities into simple, valuable user outcomes. We are looking for someone who enjoys the fast-paced startup life, can envision an AI and future-first product roadmap, drive results, is a team player and very customer-oriented.

How  You’ll  Make an Impact

- Define and drive product strategy for AI-powered features and core platform capabilities

- Build innovative 0 -> 1 solutions for the enterprise marketers and creators

- Work with engineering to   build a foundationally   solid AI-native, multi-modal content design engine

- Lead discovery across users, data, and model capabilities to identify high-impact opportunities

- Translate ambiguous problems into clear product requirements, experiments, and success metrics

- Own the lifecycle of AI features, including model iteration, evaluation, and continuous improvement

- Establish feedback loops between user behavior, product metrics, and model performance

- Balance speed and quality when shipping AI features, managing trade-offs like accuracy, latency, and cost

- Communicate product vision and decisions clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders

What  You Bring

- 7+ years of product management experience, including experience building AI-native software or application

- Bachelor’s or Master's degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field.

- Experience having defined and shipped a new AI product capability from concept through adoption

- Strong understanding of how AI/ML systems work (you don’t need to build models, but you understand their constraints)

- Experience shipping 0→1 or highly iterative products in a fast-paced environment

- Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and experimentation skills

- Excellent communication skills, you can simplify complexity for different audiences

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete information

Location
This is a hybrid role based in our Palo Alto HQ. We collaborate in-office 3 days a week.

Base Salary

The range for this role is $190,000-$210,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.
Benefits

- Competitive compensation — including salary, equity, and 401(k)

- Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family

- HSA and FSA options to support your financial wellness

- Flexible time off — including parental leave

- Well-being programs — resources to support your mental and physical health

- Daily lunch & snacks

- Mentorship & impact — work closely with top AI leaders on products that ship

Equality Opportunity Statement
We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, medical condition, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We comply with applicable laws in every jurisdiction where we operate.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

- Build something big — Be part of a fast-growing startup defining a new category: marketing orchestration powered by Agentic AI.

- Your work will matter — Trusted by Fortune 100 companies, our platform delivers 10x content velocity and 90% faster campaigns.

- A+ team — Collaborate with veterans from Meta, Amazon, Adobe, Google, Microsoft, and top AI companies.

- Backed by the best — GV, Salesforce Ventures, Microsoft, Lightspeed, Madrona and M enlo ($165M raised).

- Recognized for innovation — TIME Best Inventions, Fast Company Next Big Thing in Tech, Gartner Cool Vendor, Adweek AI Company of the Year, LinkedIn Top Startup, Webby Award (AI Work & Productivity).
